agyos_skill.intent: Azure Machine Learning SDK v2 for Python. Use for ML workspaces, jobs, models, datasets, compute, and pipelines.
agyos_skill.instructions: Client library for managing Azure ML resources: workspaces, jobs, models, data, and compute. ```bash pip install azure-ai-ml ``` ```bash AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID=<your-subscription-id> AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP=<your-resource-group> AZURE_ML_WORKSPACE_NAME=<your-workspace-name> ``` ```python from azure.ai.ml import MLClient from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential ml_client = MLClient( credential=DefaultAzureCredential(), subscription_id=os.environ["AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID"], resource_group_name=os.environ["AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP"], workspace_name=os.environ["AZURE_ML_WORKSPACE_NAME"] ) ``` ```python from azure.ai.ml import MLClient from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential ml_client = MLClient.from_config( credential=DefaultAzureCredential() )
